Name: Pelican Town Food Truck
Author: 8BitAlien
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3qIdfwF.png[/img]
Chef Elm is an enthusiastic chef who has been cooking for many years. She has been travelling around the region for a while now and felt like a change, so she has decided to make stops at Pelican Town! Elm will visit Pelican Town each Monday and Thursday to sell a random assortment of cooked dishes and other treats. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oeBEYWX.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ghw8cSH.png[/img]
Pelican Town Food Truck is compatible with the following recolours:

- Vibrant Pastoral Recolour
- Earthy Recolour

and of course, the Vanilla game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6pS9TCI.png[/img]
Notes:
- This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. 
- This mod can be added at any point in a save file without any problems.

Please don't forget to endorse this mod if you enjoy it :)
